```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 1100
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(shinyjs)

ui <- fluidPage(
  useShinyjs(),

  textInput("cor_guess", "Guess the correlation!"),

  actionButton("submit_guess", "Submit Guess"),
  actionButton("new_plot", "Generate New Plot"),
  actionButton("toggle_stats", "Hide Guess History"),

  br(), br(),

  plotOutput("graph"),

  textOutput("message"),

  plotlyOutput("stats"),

  br(),

  div(
    id = "reset_container",
    actionButton("reset_input", "Reset Game")
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  vars <- reactiveValues(
    off_values = c(),
    show_stats = TRUE,
    true_cor = NULL
  )

  x_vals <- reactiveVal()
  y_vals <- reactiveVal()

  generate_data <- function() {

    x <- rnorm(100)

    target_cor <- runif(1, -0.95, 0.95)

    z <- rnorm(100)
    z <- scale(z - cor(z, x) * x)

    y <- target_cor * scale(x) + sqrt(1 - target_cor^2) * z

    x_vals(as.numeric(x))
    y_vals(as.numeric(y))
    vars$true_cor <- cor(x, y)
  }

  generate_data()

  output$graph <- renderPlot({

    df <- data.frame(
      x = as.numeric(x_vals()),
      y = as.numeric(y_vals())
    )

    req(nrow(df) > 0)

    ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 1) +
      theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 16))
  })

  # ---- MESSAGE ----
  output$message <- renderText({

    req(input$submit_guess)

    guess <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(input$cor_guess))
    req(!is.na(guess))

    paste0(
      "Your guess was ", guess, ".\n\n",
      "The true value was ", round(vars$true_cor, 3), ".\n",
      "That is a difference of ", round(abs(guess - vars$true_cor), 3), "."
    )
  })

  output$stats <- renderPlotly({

    req(vars$show_stats)

    if (length(vars$off_values) == 0) {

      p <- ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
                 label = "Please make some guesses to see guess history.",
                 size = 6) +
        theme_void()

    } else {

      d <- data.frame(
        guess = seq_along(vars$off_values),
        error = round(vars$off_values, 5)
      )

      p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = guess, y = error)) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_line() +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
        labs(x = "Guess Number", y = "Error") 
    }

    ggplotly(p)
  })

  # ---- submit guess ----
  observeEvent(input$submit_guess, {

    guess <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(input$cor_guess))
    req(!is.na(guess))

    vars$off_values <- c(vars$off_values, guess - vars$true_cor)
  })

  # ---- new plot ----
  observeEvent(input$new_plot, {
    generate_data()
  })

  # ---- reset ----
  observeEvent(input$reset_input, {
    generate_data()
    vars$off_values <- c()
  })

  # ---- toggle ----
  observeEvent(input$toggle_stats, {

    vars$show_stats <- !vars$show_stats

    if (vars$show_stats) {
      shinyjs::show("stats")
      shinyjs::show("reset_container")
      updateActionButton(session, "toggle_stats",
                         label = "Hide Guess History")
    } else {
      shinyjs::hide("stats")
      shinyjs::hide("reset_container")
      updateActionButton(session, "toggle_stats",
                         label = "Show Guess History")
    }
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
